# Japan Trade Show Intake

> A bilingual, browser-based intake and consultation tool for overseas companies planning to exhibit at trade shows in Japan.

Use the following pages to understand or cite this application:

- [Application overview](index.md): Canonical plain-language description, inputs, workflow, data handling, and limitations.
- [Frequently asked questions](faq.html): Answers about submission behavior, storage, languages, exports, and intended use.
- [Research and source notes](research.html): Claim boundaries, implementation evidence, and verification guidance.
- [Interactive application](./): English/Japanese intake form and local application manager.
- [Repository documentation](README.md): Local setup and developer verification.

Important: This version does not transmit applications to an organizer or external API. A submission is stored only in the current browser's localStorage until the user exports or deletes it.
